Name: OverScore Media - Swag Outfits
Author: overscoremedia
Description:
OverScore Media is a distributed software, web, and digital design agency dedicated to creating unique, helpful, and novel virtual experiences.

This mod, which requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]JSON Assets[/url]﻿, adds some custom outfits to the game that your character can wear.


----------

[b][size=4]
Current Outfits:
[/size]
[/b][b]OverDark shirt with our Magentish logo[/b][b]
[/b]
[i]^ More are on the way [someday ;) ]
[/i]

----------

[size=4][b]
Where to Get:[/b]
[/size]
You can get the outfits using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] and/or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4798]Tailor Mouse Clothing Shop[/url] mods.﻿﻿
